Nadia: Quick sync — Product asked if audit event names can be customer-friendly for docs and support. They want a stable public surface while we keep internal richer verbs. Any objections to having a dual-name field (public_name, internal_name)?
Ethan: No objections. We need to be careful with RBAC changes though — adding actor.type and scope fields will affect event consumers.
Priya: From product: customers get confused by long dotted urns. If we provide a public_name that's human readable, we can map it in the UI and docs. Must be immutable once GA.
Marco: Privacy note — public_name must not leak any PII or resource identifiers. Keep it generic.
Nadia: Agreed. Proposal draft: keep canonical event id (evt_id) for machines, public_name for docs/support, and metadata for actor/context. Sample:```{"evt_id":"audit.key.create.v1","public_name":"Key created","actor":{"id":"...","type":"service_account"},"resource":"key:proj/xyz"}```
Ethan: Suggest we also add a versioned schema header and a small enum for public_name_visibility: ["public","private","support-only"]. That helps routing to external consumers vs internal logs.
Priya: Product likes visibility enum. Also request a customer-facing changelog endpoint so they're notified when public_name changes (or deprecated).
Nadia: We'll avoid renaming public_name except deprecations with a deprecation window. For audit schema changes we should follow: 1) bump schema version, 2) provide mapping table, 3) keep old fields for 90 days, 4) emit deprecation events.
Ethan: Implementation notes for infra: KV-store for name mappings + streaming transform to populate public_name at export time. This prevents changing log contents and lets us control the public view.
Priya: What about KMS/signing fields? Customer asked whether signed events will include key fingerprints or full key ids.
Marco: Only include key fingerprint (sha256) in public outputs. Full key ids must remain internal and redacted in customer-visible channels.
Nadia: Added to the spec: signed_event.{signature, signer_fingerprint}. signer_id only for internal logs.
Ethan: RBAC: new event consumers (support UI) will need read access to public audit view. We'll add a role: audit_viewer_public.
Priya: Timeline request from product: want docs & sample payloads in two weeks. Is that feasible?
Ethan: Two weeks for schema + transform pipeline POC. Full rollout needs more time.
Nadia: Action items: @Ethan spin up POC mapping + list of affected services; @Marco write privacy constraints; @Priya provide customer UX examples; I will draft the spec with versioned examples and deprecation policy.
